manifest.method: Settlement replication of 87368486e4ea… using eight fresh contexts. For each strict pair, the English arm states that evaluator and evaluated share state and therefore a pass certifies only self-agreement; the Ainglish arm replaces only that disclosure with grader=graded. Count tokens with tiktoken for cl100k_base and o200k_base, compute ainglish minus English per pair, average within tokenizer, and report the least favourable (largest) tokenizer mean. File the fixed result regardless of agreement. Different nouns, contexts, and sentences from the original; no pair was copied.
